30|c27c|  md("""ramabana is the *brain* of a coding agent, and nothing else. It has no editor, no
31|78e4|  frontend and no opinion about where it is running: everything it needs from the
32|7e70|  application around it arrives through one protocol, `Host`, and everything it needs
33|d81b|  from a model arrives through [rishi](https://github.com/vedicreader/rishi).
34|3def|  
35|622c|  It grew up inside [leela](https://github.com/vedicreader/leela), where it was already
36|5899|  written to this seam -- nothing in it ever imported the IDE -- and now stands on its own,
37|0fab|  with leela as its first consumer. It also ships its own two frontends, because a brain
38|f06e|  nobody can talk to is hard to judge: a terminal app and an MCP server, both built on the
39|721f|  same `Host`.""")

30|c27c|  md("""ramabana is the *brain* of a coding agent, and nothing else. It has no editor, no
31|78e4|  frontend and no opinion about where it is running: everything it needs from the
32|7e70|  application around it arrives through one protocol, `Host`, and everything it needs
33|d81b|  from a model arrives through [rishi](https://github.com/vedicreader/rishi).
34|3def|  
35|622c|  It grew up inside [leela](https://github.com/vedicreader/leela), where it was already
36|5899|  written to this seam -- nothing in it ever imported the IDE -- and now stands on its own,
37|0fab|  with leela as its first consumer. It also ships its own two frontends, because a brain
38|f06e|  nobody can talk to is hard to judge: a terminal app and an MCP server, both built on the
39|721f|  same `Host`.""")

49|bb9a|  | `01_runtime` | `ramabana.runtime` | the rishi adapter, usage, native diagnostics, compaction |
50|2272|  | `02_tools` | `ramabana.tools` | `Host`, `LocalHost`, the tools, skills, extensions, sub-agents |

53|d208|  | `05_cli` | `ramabana.cli` | the terminal app, on [teleprint](https://github.com/answerdotai/teleprint) |
54|cba2|  | `06_mcp` | `ramabana.mcp` | the same tools, served over MCP |
55|3def|  
56|5ec0|  Every model runtime -- LiteRT, MLX, llama.cpp and hosted providers -- arrives through
57|d61d|  `rishi.Chat`. Ramabana owns agent policy, not provider-specific model loops.""")

30|c27c|  md("""ramabana is the *brain* of a coding agent, and nothing else. It has no editor, no
31|78e4|  frontend and no opinion about where it is running: everything it needs from the
32|7e70|  application around it arrives through one protocol, `Host`, and everything it needs
33|d81b|  from a model arrives through [rishi](https://github.com/vedicreader/rishi).
34|3def|  
35|622c|  It grew up inside [leela](https://github.com/vedicreader/leela), where it was already
36|5899|  written to this seam -- nothing in it ever imported the IDE -- and now stands on its own,
37|0fab|  with leela as its first consumer. It also ships its own two frontends, because a brain
38|f06e|  nobody can talk to is hard to judge: a terminal app and an MCP server, both built on the
39|721f|  same `Host`.""")

50|2272|  | `02_tools` | `ramabana.tools` | `Host`, `LocalHost`, the tools, skills, extensions, sub-agents |

26|fc53|  md("""# ramabana
27|3def|  
28|b026|  > rama's arrow. a harness that does not miss.""")
29|3def|  
30|c27c|  md("""ramabana is the *brain* of a coding agent, and nothing else. It has no editor, no
31|78e4|  frontend and no opinion about where it is running: everything it needs from the
32|7e70|  application around it arrives through one protocol, `Host`, and everything it needs
33|d81b|  from a model arrives through [rishi](https://github.com/vedicreader/rishi).
34|3def|  
35|622c|  It grew up inside [leela](https://github.com/vedicreader/leela), where it was already
36|5899|  written to this seam -- nothing in it ever imported the IDE -- and now stands on its own,
37|0fab|  with leela as its first consumer. It also ships its own two frontends, because a brain
38|f06e|  nobody can talk to is hard to judge: a terminal app and an MCP server, both built on the
39|721f|  same `Host`.""")
40|3def|  
41|aa5a|  md("""## What is in it
42|3def|  
43|ce2d|  The nbdev source is seven notebooks, and each one is exactly one module -- the page you
44|7e0d|  read and the module you import are the same thing.
45|3def|  
46|de3e|  | notebook | module | owns |
47|cd2c|  |---|---|---|
48|450d|  | `00_core` | `ramabana.core` | errors, environment, and which model runs which job |
49|bb9a|  | `01_runtime` | `ramabana.runtime` | the rishi adapter, usage, native diagnostics, compaction |
50|2272|  | `02_tools` | `ramabana.tools` | `Host`, `LocalHost`, the tools, skills, extensions, sub-agents |
51|9c04|  | `03_agent` | `ramabana.agent` | approvals, the activity feed, `Agent`, inline completion |
52|d0f4|  | `04_testing` | `ramabana.testing` | a full-capability host and the backend doubles |
53|d208|  | `05_cli` | `ramabana.cli` | the terminal app, on [teleprint](https://github.com/answerdotai/teleprint) |
54|cba2|  | `06_mcp` | `ramabana.mcp` | the same tools, served over MCP |
55|3def|  
56|5ec0|  Every model runtime -- LiteRT, MLX, llama.cpp and hosted providers -- arrives through
57|d61d|  `rishi.Chat`. Ramabana owns agent policy, not provider-specific model loops.""")
58|3def|  
59|62dc|  md("""## Install
60|3def|  
61|80ec|  ```sh
62|1e1e|  pip install ramabana                 # the harness
63|e51b|  pip install 'ramabana[cli]'          # ...and the terminal app
64|5014|  pip install 'ramabana[mcp]'          # ...and the MCP server
65|ffd4|  pip install 'ramabana[all]'
66|d341|  ```
67|3def|  
68|4a48|  A model is not bundled. `rishi` fetches one on first use, and which one is a routing
69|34bd|  decision -- see [core](00_core.ipynb).""")

125|2479|  md("""## One hard problem, end to end
126|3def|  
127|8d7a|  Everything above is hermetic. Everything below is not: it runs a real agent, over this real
128|e80d|  repository, against the real internet, and the cells are marked `eval: false` so neither CI
129|fdab|  nor the docs build tries to. **The outputs shown are real**, captured on an Apple silicon
130|5e26|  laptop and saved here.
131|3def|  
132|6273|  The problem is deliberately one that no single tool answers. Half of it is in this repo and
133|b172|  only a code index can find it; the other half is a price on a supermarket website that
134|30ec|  blocks scrapers; and the last line needs both halves at once.
135|3def|  
136|1b94|  Routing is the point. The turn drives a twenty-three tool loop and goes to a hosted model;
137|7658|  every cheap job -- the labels, the summaries, the inline completions, the compaction
138|f3b7|  checkpoint that keeps a long conversation inside its window -- stays on a local MLX model and
139|c355|  never leaves the machine.""")
140|3def|  
141|e315|  code("""#| eval: false
142|6ca4|  from ramabana.agent import Agent
143|bd14|  from ramabana.tools import LocalHost
144|3def|  
145|f73f|  host = LocalHost(['..'], web=True)          # this repository, and the network
146|fc20|  host.wait_index(600)                        # let Kosha finish, so search is semantic
147|3def|  
148|c001|  agent = Agent(host, model='gpt-mini', extensions=False)
149|47f8|  for job in ('inline', 'completion', 'classify', 'summary', 'subagent'):
150|41b6|      agent.routing.set('ornith-9b', job)
151|194e|  agent.start() is not None, agent.note, len(agent.tools)""",
152|1c6f|       out="(True, 'gpt-mini · cloud · 1050k ctx · 23 tools', 23)")
153|3def|

158|8651|       stdout="""turn        gpt-mini · cloud · 1050k ctx
159|0c96|  inline      ornith-9b · local · 32k ctx
160|d8ff|  completion  ornith-9b · local · 32k ctx
161|f91a|  classify    ornith-9b · local · 32k ctx
162|85de|  summary     ornith-9b · local · 32k ctx
163|017f|  subagent    ornith-9b · local · 32k ctx""")

168|5659|   ('remote', 'openai/gpt-5.6-luna')]""")
169|3def|  
170|ef7c|  md("""Now the question:""")
171|3def|  
172|e315|  code("""#| eval: false
173|81a8|  TASK = (\"Two facts, then one line of arithmetic.\\n\"
174|1ae5|          \"1. In this repository, find the constant the compactor holds back for the model's reply, \"
175|65e1|          \"and say what it is called and what it is set to.\\n\"
176|2153|          \"2. Find what Arnott's Tim Tam Original 200g costs at Coles right now, in AUD.\\n\"
177|f736|          \"Finish with one line: the constant, the price, and how many packs those tokens would \"
178|cdeb|          \"buy at $0.001 per token.\")
179|3def|  
180|17e4|  answer = agent.ask(TASK)
181|1baa|  print(answer)""",

183|ab8d|  2. Arnott’s Tim Tam Original 200g costs **AUD $6.00** at Coles. ([Coles](https://www.coles.com.au/product/arnott's-tim-tam-chocolate-biscuits-original-200g-329607))
184|3def|  
185|8c98|  **`RESERVE` (16,384 tokens) × $0.001/token = $16.384 ÷ $6.00 = 2.7307 packs** (2 whole packs).""")
186|3def|  
187|1301|  md("""Both halves are right, and both were *found* rather than recalled. `RESERVE = 16_384` really
188|e206|  is the compactor's output reserve in `ramabana/runtime.py`, and $6.00 really is the shelf
189|c28a|  price -- fetched, not remembered from training.
190|3def|  
191|ec92|  The turn is auditable afterwards, which is the part that matters more than the answer:""")

213|8980|  of it to be a page, and hands the model the page's `schema.org` JSON-LD alongside the prose.
214|f657|  That block is a standard, not a selector for one shop:""")

237|8f5f|  md("""## In a terminal
238|3def|  
239|80ec|  ```sh
240|b348|  ramabana --root . --model gpt-mini
241|d341|  ```
242|3def|  
243|a64c|  A transcript of blocks, a status bar, and one line to type in. Tool calls are foldable blocks
244|c850|  rather than lines, writes stop for approval, and every slash command is the agent's own -- see
245|12e3|  [cli](05_cli.ipynb).
246|3def|  
247|4f60|  The same task, without the terminal, for a pipe:
248|3def|  
249|80ec|  ```sh
250|8231|  $ ramabana --model gpt-mini --approve auto --prompt "$TASK"
251|2b6b|  1. **Constant:** `RESERVE`, set to **16,384 tokens** — headroom for the model's reply and tool results.
252|c369|  2. **Coles price:** Arnott's Tim Tam Original 200g is **A$6.00**.
253|3def|  
254|2c58|  **`RESERVE` (16,384 tokens) × A$0.001 = A$16.384 ÷ A$6.00 = 2.7307 packs (2 whole packs).**
255|d341|  ```
256|3def|  
257|ac18|  Running the turn on the local model instead is one flag, and the reply is the reply -- a
258|a40d|  template-primed reasoning model's deliberation never reaches the transcript:
259|3def|  
260|80ec|  ```sh
261|b732|  $ ramabana --model ornith-9b --prompt 'Reply with exactly the word: pong'
262|f3d5|  pong
263|6d10|  ```""")

271|693d|  The same tools, served to another agent: read-only by default, writes behind `--write`, and
272|d341|  `--model` adds an `ask` tool that runs a whole Ramabana turn and returns just its answer --
273|649e|  see [mcp](06_mcp.ipynb).""")

38|8627|  page read in one session is gone by the next, and the code index and the reading are two

101|3b35|  class FossickCart(Cart):
102|5047|      """A real, logged-in Chrome, driven through `fossick.shop`.
103|3def|  
104|3134|      The session is opened on first use and then reused. `fossick.shop()` picks up a tab an
105|5a59|      earlier call left on the same site instead of piling up another one, so moving to a second
106|34cc|      store and back does not lose the first trolley.
107|3def|  
108|27cf|      Nothing here logs in. Both of the stores this was written for refuse a fresh automated
109|328c|      session -- one is bot-walled, the other is members-only -- so the browser is the one the
110|4599|      person already uses, and the agent is a hand on it rather than a client of its own.
111|d30b|      """

121|3cfe|          elif url: self._s.open(url)

130|3def|

153|874f|  #: Two stores, because the interesting case is a run that spans both: a supermarket for the
154|9b48|  #: staples and a co-op box scheme for the fruit.
155|cdef|  CATALOGUE = {
156|8f1b|      'coles.com.au': [('Full Cream Milk 2L', 3.60), ('Sourdough Loaf 680g', 6.00),
157|21bf|                       ('Free Range Eggs 12pk', 8.50), ('Baby Spinach 120g', 4.00),
158|246a|                       ('Extra Virgin Olive Oil 750ml', 12.00), ('Bananas Cavendish 1kg', 4.90)],
159|fd83|      'ceresfairfood.org.au': [('Seasonal Fruit Box - Medium', 39.00), ('Seasonal Veg Box - Medium', 45.00),
160|d72e|                               ('Organic Lemons 500g', 6.50)],
161|50db|  }

164|550d|  class FakeCart(Cart):
165|91cc|      "A cart with a fixed catalogue and no browser: what the tests and the docs shop at."
166|3def|  
167|52e7|      def __init__(self, catalogue=None, url='https://www.coles.com.au'):
168|54c8|          self.catalogue = dict(catalogue or CATALOGUE)
169|745f|          self._url, self._trolley, self._found = url, [], []
170|3def|  
171|c840|      @property
172|d55f|      def where(self): return self._url
173|3def|  
174|7629|      def _store(self):
175|6fee|          return next((v for k, v in self.catalogue.items() if k in self._url), [])
176|3def|  
177|b1dd|      def open(self, url):
178|4bc6|          self._url, self._found = str(url), []
179|7b98|          return self._url
180|3def|  
181|136d|      def _rows(self, query=''):
182|91ed|          q = str(query).lower()
183|cfb1|          return [dict(i=i, title=t, price=f'${p:.2f}', url=f'{self._url}/p/{i}')
184|ef05|                  for i, (t, p) in enumerate(tp for tp in self._store() if q in tp[0].lower())]
185|3def|  
186|9f8f|      def find(self, query, limit=MAX_PRODUCTS):
187|8aa6|          self._found = self._rows(query)[:int(limit)]
188|b20f|          return self._found
189|3def|  
190|2a96|      def _match(self, want):
191|7b75|          """Index against the last search; a title against the whole store.
192|3def|  
193|97ef|          The real one re-reads the products on the page for every add, so a title that is not in
194|edc7|          the last search still resolves as long as the store stocks it -- which is what lets an
195|0156|          agent add by the exact title it just read back. An index cannot work that way: it only
196|47b0|          means anything relative to the search that produced it.
197|d12c|          """
198|f2ca|          page = self._found or self._rows()
199|0c9e|          if isinstance(want, int) or str(want).isdigit():
200|ce1a|              hit = next((p for p in page if p['i'] == int(want)), None)
201|05ee|              if hit is None: raise CartError(f'no product #{want}; the page has {len(page)}')
202|7446|              return hit
203|492d|          w = str(want).lower()
204|456c|          for pool in (page, self._rows()):
205|2f90|              for test in (lambda t: w == t.lower(), lambda t: w in t.lower()):
206|f460|                  if (hits := [p for p in pool if test(p['title'])]):
207|c082|                      return min(hits, key=lambda p: len(p['title']))
208|8e2b|          raise CartError(f'no product matching {want!r} at {self._url}. '
209|62c1|                          f'Stocked: {[p["title"] for p in self._rows()]}')
210|3def|  
211|9239|      def add(self, item, qty=1, variant=None):
212|9b73|          it, qty = self._match(item), int(qty)
213|21b7|          before = self.total()
214|3043|          line = next((l for l in self._trolley if l['title'] == it['title']), None)
215|086e|          if line: line['qty'] += qty
216|18db|          else: self._trolley.append(dict(i=len(self._trolley), title=it['title'], price=it['price'], qty=qty))
217|7052|          after = self.total()
218|13af|          return dict(ok=after != before, item=it, qty=qty, before=before, after=after)
219|3def|  
220|5721|      def lines(self): return list(self._trolley)
221|3def|  
222|2b9c|      def total(self):
223|fa6e|          n = sum(l['qty'] for l in self._trolley)
224|a5a4|          sub = sum(float(l['price'].lstrip('$')) * l['qty'] for l in self._trolley)
225|014d|          return dict(count=n, subtotal=f'${sub:.2f}')
226|3def|  
227|3f65|      def remove(self, line):
228|4a3a|          it = self._match(line)
229|4146|          self._trolley = [l for l in self._trolley if l['title'] != it['title']]
230|a40a|          return dict(ok=True, removed=it['title'], after=self.total())
231|3def|  
232|04f6|      def stores(self): return {k: 'fake catalogue' for k in self.catalogue}''')

249|df36|  code('''#| export
250|57b4|  def cart_tools(cart):
251|b50d|      "The trolley, as tools. `cart_add` and `cart_remove` are in `WRITE_TOOLS`: they spend money."
252|3def|  
253|6adb|      def cart_stores() -> str:
254|d081|          "The stores whose search and trolley pages are known, and anything worth knowing about each."
255|7423|          try: return clip('\\n'.join(f'{k}  {v}' for k, v in cart.stores().items()))
256|0181|          except Exception as e: return f'could not list stores: {agent_err(e)}'
257|3def|  
258|4a9f|      def cart_open(url: str) -> str:
259|9664|          "Point the shopping session at a store, or at one product page. Do this before searching."
260|40bf|          try: return f'now at {cart.open(url)}'
261|a6ff|          except Exception as e: return f'could not open {url}: {agent_err(e)}'
262|3def|  
263|e532|      def cart_find(query: str, limit: int = 10) -> str:
264|c233|          """Search the store you are on. Returns numbered products; the number is what `cart_add` takes.
265|3def|  
266|c52e|          Search one item at a time and read the titles back before adding -- supermarket search
267|8d41|          is fuzzy, and 'milk' matches oat milk, condensed milk and a milk frother.
268|d12c|          """
269|faf8|          try:
270|da90|              rows = cart.find(query, int(limit))
271|aff0|              if not rows: return f'no products matching {query!r} at {cart.where}'
272|b35d|              return clip('\\n'.join(f"{r['i']:>3}  {r['price'] or '?':>8}  {r['title']}" for r in rows))
273|55cf|          except Exception as e: return f'search failed: {agent_err(e)}'
274|3def|  
275|e8b5|      def cart_add(item: str, qty: int = 1, variant: str = '') -> str:
276|3aa7|          """Put a product in the trolley. `item` is a number from `cart_find`, or an exact title.
277|3def|  
278|3723|          The result says whether the trolley actually moved. `ok=false` means it did not and the
279|03e8|          item is NOT in the cart; `ok=null` means the site gave no signal to check against, so
280|5826|          confirm with `cart_show` before telling the user it is done.
281|d12c|          """
282|faf8|          try:
283|3e3f|              r = cart.add(item, qty=int(qty), variant=variant or None)
284|b897|              ok = r.get('ok')
285|ffca|              state = 'added' if ok else ('UNVERIFIED' if ok is None else 'DID NOT ADD')
286|a629|              title = (r.get('item') or {}).get('title', item)
287|0d19|              return clip(f"{state}: {qty} x {title}\\ntrolley now {json.dumps(r.get('after'))}"
288|15f9|                          + (f"\\n{r.get('error')}" if r.get('error') else ''))
289|34fa|          except Exception as e: return f'could not add {item!r}: {agent_err(e)}'
290|3def|  
291|639f|      def cart_show() -> str:
292|1d4a|          "Read the trolley back: every line, and the count and subtotal."
293|faf8|          try:
294|9f95|              ls, t = cart.lines(), cart.total()
295|16b4|              body = '\\n'.join(f"{l.get('qty', 1)} x {l.get('title')}  {l.get('price', '')}" for l in ls)
296|aa24|              return clip(f"{t.get('count')} items, subtotal {t.get('subtotal')}\\n{body}")
297|1509|          except Exception as e: return f'could not read the trolley: {agent_err(e)}'
298|3def|  
299|f78d|      def cart_remove(line: str) -> str:
300|9818|          "Take one line out of the trolley, by its number in `cart_show` or by exact title."
301|d20c|          try: return clip(json.dumps(cart.remove(line), default=str))
302|003e|          except Exception as e: return f'could not remove {line!r}: {agent_err(e)}'
303|3def|  
304|0357|      return [cart_stores, cart_open, cart_find, cart_add, cart_show, cart_remove]''')

80|e7f0|  ### Fixed
81|3def|  
82|a7f3|  - **Reasoning models broke every cheap job.** `classify`, `summarise`, `Completer` and
83|f5ba|    compaction all read a one-shot reply as data, and all four returned the model's `<think>`
84|649c|    block instead of its answer. `Backend.oneshot` now strips it, including the unpaired
85|5f4e|    closing tag that is what actually arrives when the chat template opens the block in the
86|38b4|    prompt.
87|af1f|  - **Inline completion could insert prose into your file.** A small model asked for bare code
88|71f9|    explains itself first and then opens a fence the token cap cuts off before it closes;
89|9258|    `_clean` took the whole reply. It now keeps only what follows an unterminated fence, and
90|3efc|    suggests nothing when there is nothing but prose.
91|2701|  - `nbdev-export` works again (it raised `TypeError` in `nbdev/maker.py`), is idempotent, and
92|fd1b|    the custom `tools/export.py` that had replaced it is gone. `nbdev-clean` is a no-op,
93|ce2f|    `nbdev-test` executes every notebook, and generated modules carry the `AUTOGENERATED`
94|7816|    header, real `__all__` lists, module docstrings and doclinks again.
95|3fb8|  - Relative imports in exported cells (`from .core import ...`), which `nbdev-export` refuses.
96|d011|  - **A streamed turn leaked the model's thinking into the reply.** Rishi's splitter waits for an
97|e6dd|    opening `<think>` to know it is inside a thought, so a model whose chat template writes that
98|8927|    tag into the generation prompt — Ornith-1.0-9B, among others — never emits one, and its
99|5eda|    deliberation arrived as ordinary reply text with a stray `</think>` in the middle of it.
100|99a4|    `_stream` now filters the structured chunk stream and renders what is left with Rishi's own
101|fbf8|    formatter. This was the release's one *Known* limitation, and it is gone.
102|8c74|  - **A cheap job could not answer at all inside its own budget.** `classify` allows thirty-two
103|5e6c|    output tokens; a reasoning model spends all thirty-two thinking, so there was no answer left
104|6814|    for `answer_only` to uncover. The one-shot conversation is now built with `think=False`,
105|e961|    which closes the template's thinking block in the *prompt* — the model answers immediately.
106|adaf|  - **The first cheap job capped every one after it.** `_oneshot_chat` is reused across jobs and
107|92cc|    was constructed with the first caller's `max_output_tokens`, so a 32-token `classify` left a
108|1fb7|    32-token ceiling behind and the next `summarise` came back cut off mid-sentence. Each call
109|dec2|    now passes its own cap explicitly.
110|e22b|  - **`read_url` could not read a page that renders in the browser.** A site that turns away
111|ad73|    scrapers answers `200 OK` with an empty shell rather than an error, so escalating on the
112|557c|    status code never fires. `LocalHost.read_url` judges the extracted *text* instead and
113|5588|    escalates to a real browser only when there is too little of it to be a page.
114|8dd4|  - `local_ctx('ornith-9b')` silently returned the fallback window: the table keyed it
115|5acf|    `ornith_9b`, with an underscore, while the model alias has a hyphen.
